sources.population: Meta High Resolution Population Density, Malaysia general 2020 (30 m), 127,465 pixels inside the Majlis Bandaraya Ipoh boundary, scaled per hexagon to the notebook’s 2026 totals
sources.p65: DOSM Census 2020 share aged 65+ per census area (Bandar areas estimated as in the notebook)

calibration.method: Straight-line distance from each 100 m cell to the nearest facility, scaled by a street-detour factor k (walking at 0.9 m/s) or an effective straight-line driving speed s (km/min, plus 2 min access). k and s are fitted so the existing facilities reproduce the notebook’s street-routed results (curves in Part 2; bus stops: 16% within 400 m, 23% within 500 m). Care homes have no routed curve, so they use the mean of the clinic and hospital fits.
